morocco-2025.notes: The Codeforces contest is named as a mirror: 'The 2025 ICPC Moroccan Collegiate Programming Contest (Mirror)'. No date or place on the pages; the pack's location 'Sudan' is not confirmed by them. Figures of problems A and G are external images not in our copy.
